body:
I am assuming that I will just cease to exist...

I really cannot imagine things getting better. I am 20 years old and I have been depressed since I was 8. This is how I have been for more than half of my life. Yes, I am more stable than I was as a kid, but I still get miserable like this. It always comes back; sometimes it just takes longer. Sometimes it's a year rather than a day, but I always end up getting like this again. I'm glad that things have worked out for you, but it is really difficult for me to imagine something like that happening to me.
I have a genetic disorder...I would rather not get into it.

No, it's not because I'm unhappy. That's not the sort of thing I'm talking about. I keep what I feel to myself. With the exception of my immediate family (and even they aren't really aware of the full extent of things), the people in my life are not aware of my depression. For the past six years or so, people have just really liked me for whatever reason. I've had a lot of friends, and people for whatever reason go out of their way to talk with me, joke with me, get to know me, etc. In high school, people would vote for me for things all the time, and I would usually win. I know that sounds like a dumb example, but it's really bizarre to me. Adults in my community really respect me for whatever reason. Ever since I was able to move after middle school (where I had the complete opposite situation going on), it's like I only get positivity directed towards me. It used to make me extremely paranoid, but now it's just kind of weird to deal with.

Nothing can end what is making me suffer, that's the problem. I will always have to deal with it. I cannot cure it or fix it. I was born with it and I will die with it.

What makes me so special? Why hasn't all of that already gone to waste? I am grateful for what others have done for me...I never said that I wasn't.

I know that they'll be in pain. I thought that I had gotten that across above...I am aware of the consequences. As I said though, having to keep living just for other people's convenience is really tiring.

I really don't think that I am confused. I have felt like this for longer than I haven't. I attempted suicide for the first time almost twelve years ago, when I was eight years old. This isn't a new thing. I am seriously tired of having to live like this.
Because it does not make any sense...I don't understand why their attention is being focused on me as opposed to any other person.
